about_short_description.short_description: Telli is a supplier of personal care, furniture, equipment, grooming and bathrobes products to the spa, saloon and hospitality sectors.

product.name: Wholesale Beauty Supplies
product.description: Bulk beauty products for salons, spas, and hotels including personal care, grooming, and bathrobes.

product.name: Spa and Salon Equipment
product.description: Equipment for spa and salon operations including massage tables, steam room and sauna equipment, and mani-pedi stations.

product.name: Salon and Spa Furniture
product.description: Furniture products for salons and spas including chairs, stools, loungers, and treatment tables.

product.name: Disinfectants and Sanitization Products
product.description: Disinfectants and sanitization supplies for maintaining hygiene in salons and spas, including Barbicide products and surface wipes.

product.name: Massage and Body Care Products
product.description: Products for massage and body treatments such as massage oils, waxes, and body care items.

product.name: Manicure and Pedicure Supplies
product.description: Tools and kits for nail care including files, buffers, brushes, and pedicure kits.
